title: Easwaran's unbeaten 61 steers Bengal to seven-wicket win over Jharkhand
dek: Bengal chased 149 with eight balls to spare in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy in Mumbai, after Sayan Ghosh, Rishabh Chaudhary and Mukesh Kumar took two wickets each.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Abhimanyu Easwaran made an unbeaten 61 and Abishek Porel 49 as Bengal beat Jharkhand by seven wickets in their Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Elite Group A match in Mumbai on Wednesday, two days after their 85-run win over Chandigarh in the national T20 championship.

Sent in after Bengal chose to bowl at the MCA's Sharad Pawar Cricket Academy ground at the Bandra-Kurla Complex, Jharkhand made 148 for 7 in 20 overs, according to the BCCI scorecard. Virat Singh top-scored with 45 not out and Shikhar Mohan made 42, reports said. Sayan Ghosh took 2 for 23, Rishabh Chaudhary 2 for 31 and Mukesh Kumar 2 for 36.

Bengal reached 149 for 3 in 18.4 overs, with eight balls to spare, the scorecard shows.

Mukesh, the India seamer, had taken 4 for 9 against Chandigarh on Monday. The tournament is being played as IPL franchises prepare for the 2027 player auction, after retention lists were submitted on Tuesday.
